inputs.prompt: Create a full-body 3D game character reference of the man in the FIRST image, keeping his exact face, swept-back dark wavy hair, light stubble, eyebrows and skin tone so he is clearly recognizable. Match the rendering style, framing, lighting, scale and pose of the SECOND image exactly (use the second image only for style and pose, not for identity). Slightly stylized realistic video-game look. He wears a casual athletic outfit for table tennis: a fitted heather grey polo shirt, black athletic shorts, white sports socks and white sneakers. No necklace. Standing in a neutral symmetrical T-pose, arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height, palms down, fingers together, legs slightly apart, feet flat, facing directly at the camera. Entire body visible from head to toe with margin around it, centered. Plain solid light grey background, even soft studio lighting, no shadows, no props, no text.
